With Fintelite’s AI-powered technology, especially the bank statement analyzer and document forensics, lending companies can streamline their processes more effectively. He also emphasized that in the lending industry, a solution like Fintelite AI is essential. It not only speeds up the loan process but also improves customer satisfaction and overall operational efficiency.
